summary: The Strategy pattern passes the rule for a task into an object instead of writing every rule inside it. In Java, the strategy is an interface, and a lambda or method reference can fill it in.
notes: GradingStrategy has one abstract method, so it is a functional interface. Any lambda with the same parameters and return type fits.
Main::dropLowest is a method reference: it passes the method without calling it.
LinkedHashMap keeps entries in the order you put them, so the output order is predictable.
pitfall: Dividing two ints, such as (sum - min) / (scores.length - 1), drops the decimal part. Cast one side to double first: (double) (sum - min).
